android.desc:
This app can only be used by children and parents of the Hermann School. No use is possible without an account and QR code from our school!

Modified messenger for the privacy-compliant use of our own matrix server. More information about the matrix protocol: https://matrix.org/

The Hermannpost is a modified version of FluffyChat: https://fluffychat.im/de/.

FluffyChat is a full-fledged messenger and can be downloaded here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=chat.fluffy.fluffychat

FluffyChat and Hermannpost are open source, the source code is public and can be used or changed under the same license. Big thanks to the developers of FluffyChat and the open source community!

Our preview mockups were created using 'Previewed' at https://previewed.app

quotes.story_title: A German school forked FluffyChat, a Matrix messenger
